name: Wei Jian Tan
bio:
Wei Jian Tan's path to Formula 1 finance began unconventionally. Initially a mathematics prodigy, he found himself drawn to the intricate financial modeling required in motorsports after attending the Singapore Grand Prix as a student. He started his career at a smaller racing team, meticulously managing budgets and identifying cost-saving opportunities that allowed the team to punch above their weight. His reputation for fiscal responsibility and sharp analytical skills soon caught the attention of Red Bull Racing.

As Finance Controller, Wei Jian is the gatekeeper of the team's financial health. He is known for his rigorous approach to budgeting, ensuring that every dollar spent contributes to on-track performance. Wei Jian is fiercely independent and trusts his own judgement above all else, sometimes leading to friction with other departments. He is driven by the belief that financial discipline is just as crucial as engineering innovation in achieving championship success.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Wei Jian is a man of average height with a serious demeanor, often seen squinting slightly as he pores over spreadsheets.

quirks: Always carries a small abacus for quick calculations.
Insists on using a fountain pen for signing important documents.
Refuses to attend team social events, claiming they are a waste of company resources.
